defaults.safe_compactness_limits: chip <= 22 chars; subline <= 120 chars planning bounds

exports.mitigation: single disclosure block with bullets; avoid duplicate warnings in subtitle and footer

score_rollups.mitigation: context panel summarizing dominant risk categories without legal essay

anti_patterns_to_avoid: Green Compliant chip without adjacent disclosure on declaration or partial states
Current validation language on EXPIRY_REVIEW_REQUIRED without review cue
Resolved or passed wording on ASSESSMENT_FOLLOWUP_REQUIRED or OPERATIONALLY_OPEN
implementation_notes: Prefer neutral nouns over authority adjectives on risky states.
Pair every compact chip with subline or tooltip on CLIENT_STATUS_CHIP unless VERIFIED_CURRENT.
Use Recorded / Partial / Open / Review due instead of Compliant / Current when uncertain.

anti_patterns_to_avoid: Score headline that implies operational closure when follow-ups remain
implementation_notes: Describe what the number aggregates (recorded signals), not legal outcome.
Add mixed-state caveat when portfolio blends semantic states.
Defer closure language to requirement-level detail.

anti_patterns_to_avoid: Export title implying portfolio-wide compliance from mixed semantic states
Score headline that implies operational closure when follow-ups remain
implementation_notes: Mandatory disclosure block for non-safe states before evidence tables.
Summary sentence stating verification vs declaration distinction where relevant.
Avoid binary compliant/non-compliant chapter titles when states are mixed.

CLIENT_STATUS_CHIP.compact_label_constraints: neutral tokens unless VERIFIED_CURRENT; no standalone Compliant/Current/Verified on risky states

PORTFOLIO_SCORE.compact_label_constraints: no portfolio-wide compliant language; mixed-state caveat

REPORT_EXPORT.compact_label_constraints: non-safe states require disclosure block before tables

disclosure_placement_guidance: Place disclosure within one tap/scroll of the headline it qualifies.
Do not bury sole disclaimer in footer if headline makes a strong claim.
highest_risk_ux_anti_patterns: Green Compliant chip without adjacent disclosure on declaration or partial states
Current validation language on EXPIRY_REVIEW_REQUIRED without review cue
Resolved or passed wording on ASSESSMENT_FOLLOWUP_REQUIRED or OPERATIONALLY_OPEN
Export title implying portfolio-wide compliance from mixed semantic states
Score headline that implies operational closure when follow-ups remain
phase: Governance-Aware UX Trust Architecture Planning Phase 5
prohibited_compression_patterns: Export subtitle Valid without expiry review context
remaining_runtime_limitation: Planning artifact does not observe live user comprehension or A/B outcomes.
remaining_state_model_limitation: UX trust architecture maps governance semantics to presentation layers; runtime binding per record is out of scope.

remediation_sequencing_plan.description: Establish neutral vocabulary and layer rules before visual polish.
Align disclosure adjacency and pairing patterns across surfaces.
Introduce truthful compact labels only where layers exist.
Metrics and unknown-mapping strings without copy churn.

safe_chip_wording_guidance: Prefer neutral nouns over authority adjectives on risky states.
Pair every compact chip with subline or tooltip on CLIENT_STATUS_CHIP unless VERIFIED_CURRENT.
Use Recorded / Partial / Open / Review due instead of Compliant / Current when uncertain.
safe_export_summary_guidance: Mandatory disclosure block for non-safe states before evidence tables.
Summary sentence stating verification vs declaration distinction where relevant.
Avoid binary compliant/non-compliant chapter titles when states are mixed.
safe_score_summary_guidance: Describe what the number aggregates (recorded signals), not legal outcome.
Add mixed-state caveat when portfolio blends semantic states.
Defer closure language to requirement-level detail.
safest_truthful_simplifications: VERIFIED_CURRENT: short Verified (scope unchanged) with optional scope footnote
Neutral Missing / Not recorded for absent evidence
Partial / Evidence needed paired with subline
Follow-up pending with visible next-step affordance
scope: implementation planning for truthful simplification and disclosure layering; audit-only
tooltip_and_modal_guidance: Tooltip for density; modal for obligation-heavy explanations.
Reuse consistent Why this matters framing across surfaces.

COMPLETENESS_PENDING.compression_risk_note: Single headline labels risk semantic collapse.
COMPLETENESS_PENDING.disclosure_required_note: Pair compact signal with explanation affordance.
COMPLETENESS_PENDING.when_safe: Prefer contextual summary plus disclosure support.

DECLARATION_RECORDED.compression_risk_note: Chip-only compliance wording collapses declaration vs verification.
DECLARATION_RECORDED.when_safe: Only with explicit not-independently-verified disclosure paired on same surface.

EXPIRY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.compression_risk_note: Current language implies validity without review.
EXPIRY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.disclosure_required_note: Expiry basis or review prompt adjacent.
EXPIRY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.when_safe: Never current/valid-only chips without expiry-review cue.

OPERATIONALLY_OPEN.when_safe: Open/in-progress tokens only with operational context.

PARTIALLY_COMPLETE.disclosure_required_note: Outstanding evidence must be visible adjacent to any compact signal.
PARTIALLY_COMPLETE.when_safe: Never safe as a single green success signal.
